scope: Saved aggregate results used by the manuscript. The source SHA-256 identifies the original output. Crop-adapter singer lists and Music4All artist breakdowns are omitted here. Checkpoint paths in the new measured-response trial are reduced to filenames. Includes supplemental comparisons on an identical condition set, extra speech baselines, the low-pass bandwidth control, and the original response and backing-track selection. Journal revision: common-set intervals for the five core models use sorted singer order and a single 2,000-draw specification. The archived manifest-order intervals are preserved in trial-audit.json.

new_measured_response_and_galleries.analysis: held-out responses and new singer cohorts for this reverb question

selected_fresh_inference.note: fresh inference on source dataset crops; trial metric independently reimplemented; existing embeddings compared on same six conditions
